Class PythonUtil

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.pybridge.PythonUtil
public final class PythonUtil extends Object
The API of the embedded Python of Bio7 for Java, Groovy and BeanShell scripts (as REval for R; Python scripts use the module bio7). The variables are created in the namespace of the Python console and of the scripts (__main__). 
PythonUtil.toPython("x", 1.0, 2.0, 3.0);           // numpy array
PyValue mean = PythonUtil.fromPython("float(x.mean())");
PythonUtil.imageToPython("img");                   // the current ImageJ image
PythonUtil.pythonToR("x", "xr");                   // Python -> R
PythonUtil.rToPython("summary(cars)", "s");        // R -> Python
